headline: US hurricane forecasters leaned heavily on Google DeepMind's AI weather model to judge how strong Hurricane Isaias would become.
score_reason: Lowered from 5: the facts come from CNN's 8 Oct 2026 report already in our 9 Oct edition, and the New York Times piece could not be read.
importance_line: It shows AI guidance helping forecasters warn earlier about strong storms, which matters most to people on the Gulf Coast, though forecasters still check it against observations and other models also pointed to a hurricane landfall.
summary: Moneycontrol, relaying a CNN report of 8 Oct 2026 that our 9 Oct edition also carried, says the US National Hurricane Center gave heavy weight to Google DeepMind's AI model, which pointed early to Isaias becoming a Category 2 hurricane while several traditional models predicted a weaker storm. Director Michael Brennan said the model had been more consistent from one forecast to the next, but forecasters still check it against observations and other forecasting systems also pointed to a hurricane landfall.
notes: Pool item is a New York Times article (9 Oct 2026, HTTP 403), which was not read. Entry built from Moneycontrol (relaying CNN) and WDSU. url is the Moneycontrol page where the text was read; the NYT link is https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/09/weather/ai-models-hurricane-isaias.html.
